values.note: $20 a night, with the fee and registration procedure posted at the campground kiosk. A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry to every state forest campground.

fees.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsn-z/northgemini ('Overnight fees ($20 for most sites) and registration procedures are posted at the information kiosk at each campground'; 'A Recreation Passport (park pass) is required for vehicle entry into all state park and forest campgrounds') + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/state-forest-campgrounds/amenity-table (North Gemini Lake State Forest Campground, Schoolcraft: 17 sites, $20, managed by Indian Lake SP 906-341-2355, 'Reservable at MiDNRReservations.com' no), read 2026-10-25

facilities.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsn-z/northgemini ('There are vault toilets.' 'Potable (drinking) water is available from a hand-pump well.'), read 2026-10-25

booking.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsn-z/northgemini ('No reservations. Sites available on a first-come, first-served basis.' 'Camping is limited to a 15-day maximum stay.') + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/state-forest-campgrounds/amenity-table (North Gemini Lake State Forest Campground: 'Reservable at MiDNRReservations.com' no), read 2026-10-25

values.note: 17 sites 'suitable for tents and small trailers' in two loops (the DNR's standard state forest wording; no maximum length posted), some with direct water access. One camping unit and six people per site.

sites.source: https://www.michigan.gov/recsearch/sfcampgroundsn-z/northgemini ('Divided into two loops, it features 17 site suitable for tents and small trailers, some with direct water access'; 'One camping unit and six people are allowed per site') + https://www.michigan.gov/dnr/things-to-do/camping-and-lodging/state-forest-campgrounds/amenity-table (17 campsites), read 2026-10-25

note: Rustic state forest campground in two loops on the shore of 120-acre Gemini Lake in northwest Schoolcraft County; central boat launch. 20 mi NE of Shingleton via H-15, H-58 and Twin Lake Truck Trail, 5 mi from Pictured Rocks National Lakeshore. ORVs and snowmobiles may ride between the campground and Trail 8. --Claude
summary: DNR page + SF amenity table: $20 (confirmed), no electric, vault toilets, hand-pump water, first-come only, 15-day max (all confirmed, derived -> manual), 17 sites in two loops confirmed. Season 'open all year' (roads not plowed) already manual. Not equestrian; the DNR allows ORVs and snowmobiles between the campground and Trail 8 but does not call it an ORV trail camp. Access via H-15, H-58 and Twin Lake Truck Trail (a forest truck trail; no road warning). Note: Pictured Rocks distance corrected (~10 mi -> 5 mi, per the page), field restatements trimmed.
flags: Phone: the entry has none. The DNR campground page and the amenity table give 906-341-2355 (Indian Lake State Park, the managing park).
